text.tspan: Cancer death rates in children under 10 years old
Reported annual death rate from childhood cancers, per 100,000 children aged under ten, based on the
underlying cause listed on death certificates. This is shown for all malignant cancers combined, brain and
nervous system cancers, leukemia, lymphomas and multiple myeloma.
